    LEAST(

        CASE WHEN q2_r IS NOT NULL THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ('00:' || q2_r)::interval) END,
        CASE WHEN q3_r IS NOT NULL THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ('00:' || q3_r)::interval) END
    ) as best_lap_seconds
FROM qualifying

-- Step 1: For each qualifying session, get the pole position time and each driver's best lap
WITH qualifying_times AS (
    SELECT 
        rbind,
        pilotrec,
        px_pos,
        LEAST(
            CASE WHEN q1_r IS NOT NULL THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ('00:' || q1_r)::interval) END,
            CASE WHEN q2_r IS NOT NULL THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ('00:' || q2_r)::interval) END,
            CASE WHEN q3_r IS NOT NULL THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ('00:' || q3_r)::interval) END
        ) as best_lap_seconds
    FROM qualifying
),
pole_times AS (
    SELECT rbind, best_lap_seconds as pole_time
    FROM qualifying_times
    WHERE px_pos = 1
),
driver_deficits AS (
    SELECT 
        qt.pilotrec,
        qt.rbind,
        qt.px_pos,
        qt.best_lap_seconds - pt.pole_time as deficit_from_pole
    FROM qualifying_times qt
    JOIN pole_times pt ON qt.rbind = pt.rbind
)
